title: Odd parity acceptance from dictator acceptance
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a sign tester on $2k+1$ coordinates. Suppose every check of $T$ uses a predicate accepting exactly when the product of three input signs equals a fixed sign, and $T$ accepts each individual coordinate function with probability $1$. Then $T$ accepts the parity of all $2k+1$ coordinates with probability $1$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a sign tester on 2k+1 coordinates

T accepts each coordinate function with probability exactly 1
